assessments.reasoning: The scope and visibility passage separately defines qualification and unqualified visibility. A redeclared name has two in-scope declarations and only the inner declaration is visible unqualified. The text explicitly limits reaching the outer declaration to a qualifying declaring-unit name.

challenge.method: Check the named-qualifier case against the unnamed outer block and same-level subunit examples.
challenge.results: The marker for the declaring unit is essential. The unnamed outer block prevents the qualification in Example 2-17. This declaration scope is distinct from unqualified reference and is not a database namespace-resolution rule.

limitations: The rule is scoped to identifiers of nested PL/SQL units. SQL query column resolution, synonyms, and privilege checks have separate rules.
